\documentclass{ximera}

\title{ximera-feedback fixture}
\author{Phase 0}

\begin{document}
\begin{abstract}
Fixture for the \texttt{ximera-feedback} spec. One problem with both an \texttt{attempt} feedback (shown after any submission) and a \texttt{correct} feedback (shown only when the problem completes). The \texttt{script}-flavor feedback is not exercised --- it is deferred with \texttt{ximera-validator}.
\end{abstract}

\maketitle

\begin{problem}
  My favorite number is $y = \answer{17}$.

  \begin{feedback}[attempt]
    You made a first attempt --- keep trying!
  \end{feedback}

  \begin{feedback}[correct]
    I have always loved the number 17.  It is prime, and it is the sum of the first four primes.
  \end{feedback}
\end{problem}

\begin{problem}
  Find two integers that sum to twenty-five, or rather
  \[
    \sqrt{\answer{16}} = 4 = \frac{8}{\answer{2}}.
  \]

  \begin{feedback}[attempt]
    Not quite --- check your arithmetic.
  \end{feedback}
\end{problem}

\end{document}
